questions.scenario: A program has completed a phase, and the program manager seeks authorization to proceed to the next phase. The governance board wants evidence of program status before granting approval.
questions.stem: What should the program manager do to obtain authorization to proceed?
options: Present the program status at a stage gate review to the governance authorities to obtain the authorizations and approvals needed to proceed to the next phase.
Ask the investment committee to re-evaluate the program against competing portfolio components and reauthorize its funding allocation.
Proceed to the next phase without a stage gate review to avoid delaying the program.
Delegate the authorization decision to the constituent project managers.
questions.explanation: ガバナンス上、次フェーズへの移行認可は、ステージゲートレビューでガバナンス当局にプログラム状況を提示して認可・承認を得ることで行う（A）。Bは投資委員会による構成要素間の再評価・資金再認可というポートフォリオ視点の判断であり、フェーズゲート通過の手続きとは異なる。Cはゲートを飛ばす統制不全、Dは認可権限のないプロジェクトマネジャーへの委譲で不適切。
